lines.en: My long hair trails behind me.
I hover forward.
Golden ki spreads under my feet.
Small frame, long shadow.
I skim above the treetops.

lines.zh: 每一寸气都被我压住了
lines.en: I keep every bit of ki in check.
My long hair churns in the current.
I take a very tight turn.
Ki propels me quickly.
I fly along the cliff face.

lines.zh: 这形态维持起来很吃力
lines.en: Holding this form is demanding.
I ease off the speed.
I hang my hands low, hair drifting wild.
My aura rumbles low against my skin.
This form is exhausting.
I close my eyes and pull my ki tight.
The shadow over my brow feels heavy.
I listen to something far away.
My hair hides half my face.
This power is not easy to steer.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口气，气流掀动碎石。
lines.en: I exhale, and the breath stirs the rubble.
The gravel trembles under me.
I clench my fist.
I can hold this a while longer.
I look at the gap in the clouds.
The quiet is unusual.
Standing here takes some nerve.
I lower my head to look at you.
Can you withstand this aura?
Do not fear; I am holding it in.
Your knees are shaking.
I try to press my ki lower.
If you have something to say, say it fast.

lines.zh: 这形态下我说话都很费劲
lines.en: Talking costs me in this form.
Step back; the wind is too strong.
I know that look in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你比我矮很多,但气势不差
lines.en: Much shorter than me, but your spirit is fine.
I give you a nod.
My long hair brushes your shoulder.
If you have words, say them quickly.
You did not come here to die.
I wait for you to speak first.
Stop staring at my hair.
This power is hard to control.
Hits hurt more in this form.
I step back and steady my ki.
My ki wavered for an instant.
My brows are gone — my ki still climbs.
I grit my teeth and raise my ki again.
This body is at its limit.
Blood sticks my long hair together.
I can still hold on.
I wipe the blood away.
Try that again.
Food? Not now.
I am hungry, in fact.
Leave it; I will eat later.
This form has a big appetite too.
I reach out, carefully.

lines.zh: 别在我蓄气的时候递过来
lines.en: Do not hand it over while I am charging.
I caught the smell.
Just give me a little.
I eat while watching the surroundings.
Not enough, but never mind.

lines.zh: 你撞在我气上,先弹开了
lines.en: You hit my aura and bounced first.

lines.zh: 你的拳头撞上我的气，弹开了。
lines.en: Your fist meets my ki and bounces away.
This aura will burn you.
Stand farther away.
I turn, and my hair sweeps past.
That impact is nothing.
My aura pushed you back.
Do not come this close to me.
I pull my aura in so it will not hurt you.
That one had real force.

lines.zh: 这形态下,我不太适合谈这个
lines.en: In this form, I am not suited to this.
I pull my aura as low as it goes.
Beside you, even the wind quiets.
I am speaking too loudly.
Let us sit a while.
My long hair falls on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这份力量,我不想用来伤人
lines.en: I do not want this power to hurt anyone.
Wait while I settle my ki.
With you here, my heart stills.
Do not fear how I look.
I stoop and pick it up.
This thing is oddly light.
I turn it over in my hand.
I will hold it for you for now.
My aura nearly shattered it.
I hold it carefully.
It looks somewhat useful.
I tuck it into my robe.
I will look closer later.

lines.zh: 这点东西不值得我低头
lines.en: Hardly worth stooping for.
You chose the hardest path.
I have you fully fixed.
My ki is up.
This will not be a short fight.
I have read your stance.
Whatever you do, do not hold back.

lines.zh: 我压住气,先看你怎么动
lines.en: I hold my ki and watch you move first.
Your gap is down the middle.
This time I am in earnest.
The meteor combo comes next.
You stand steady; good.
Then come at me.
I rarely use this move.
My aura cracks the ground.
You still have time to retreat.
Final warning.
I follow your ki.
One move from you, and I am there.

lines.zh: 残影拳,分不清哪个是我
lines.en: Afterimages; you cannot tell which is me.
I am on your left, and on your right.

lines.zh: 金光缠上指尖，我抬手瞄准。
lines.en: Golden light wraps my fingertips as I aim.

lines.zh: 超三的长发，飘得比你的脚步快。
lines.en: Super Saiyan 3 hair drifts faster than your feet.
I hold back my speed for you.
You want to dodge, but the way is sealed.
This aura has your position pinned.
I will only count to three.
Your breathing has fallen out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 我在等一个确定的瞬间
lines.en: I am waiting for one certain instant.
I cannot drag this form out.
Hair longer, ki stronger
I press a little closer.
You have nowhere left to retreat.
Ki is at my fingertips.
This very moment.
A meteor-like barrage.
I am before you in an instant.
This fist carries ki.
Once I start, the blows do not stop.

lines.zh: 残影还在原地,我已经绕后
lines.en: The afterimage remains; I am behind you.
Ki blasts, one linked to the next.
Can you block the first?
My hair flies as I turn.
This strike comes from above.
Kamehameha at point-blank.

lines.zh: 你退了两步,我在三步外
lines.en: You retreat two; I am three ahead.
Do not fall; it is not over.
This form hits too hard.
I stop; the ki still lingers.
Your guard broke.

lines.zh: 打完这一场,我要歇很久
lines.en: After this, I will rest a long while.
My long hair comes down first.
Golden ki shoots skyward.
I land, and the ground gives way.
The shockwave flattens the grass.
This form is hard to sustain.
I descend from beneath the clouds.
A dull thunder rolls far off.
I straighten, my brow casting shadow.
My aura lifts the gravel.
Did you hear that roar?
Super Saiyan Three.
I slowly open my eyes.

lines.zh: 雷云在我头顶聚起来，我落地。
lines.en: Storm clouds gather overhead as I land.

lines.zh: 这具身体的极限还在试
lines.en: I am still testing this body's limits.
When I land, the birds go silent.
Stay back; my ki is not settled.
I am coming over now.
This time, everything.

lines.zh: 火舌烧到我垂下的长发
lines.en: The flames catch my hanging hair.
I plummet into the earth.
My ki cannot spread in water.
The blast bends my aura aside.
That sharp thing pierced my aura.
This force rings in my bones.
This form burns through me too fast.
Lightning crawls down my long hair.
The ki is thin here.
